experiment: CLoSD official no-finetune checkpoint matched evaluation
interpretation: Compared under the same evaluator with the epoch-66000 pilot fine-tune, the official no-finetune checkpoint scores higher on reach, pooled strike, and sit, but lower on get-up. The upstream evaluator pools kick and punch outcomes into shared strike counters. This is a 512-environment pilot, not the paper's 4096-environment configuration.
